components.name: Attribution table
components.description: Proportional traffic and revenue segments sit behind stable, borderless rows. Values roll during live updates. Hover or focus a country to reveal revenue, or use Show revenue on touch devices. Pause stops the three-second demo updates.

components.name: Rolling number
components.description: Individual digits roll inside fixed-width masks. Thousands separators and currency stay legible; the final number is exposed as one accessible label. Try crossing a digit boundary or changing direction.

components.name: Visitor table
components.description: A compact visitor list with an overlapping avatar and country flag, a source pill, and right-aligned revenue. Value animations share the same numeric primitive as the attribution table.

components.name: Button
components.description: Actions with a clear hierarchy. Use one primary action per region, secondary for alternatives, and ghost for low emphasis.

components.name: Icon button
components.description: Compact actions with accessible names. Toggle buttons expose pressed state, and disabled actions remain visible.

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: Switch between mutually exclusive views. Each control exposes its selected state and supports arrow-key navigation.

components.name: Text input
components.description: Labeled fields with persistent hints and associated validation messages. Error meaning is communicated with text as well as color.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Turn a setting on or off immediately. Each switch has a descriptive label and a generous interaction area.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Use checkboxes for independent choices that can be combined.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Use radio buttons for a single selection within a set.

components.name: Badge & status
components.description: Quiet status indicators with semantic text colors. A dot, label, or sign carries the meaning beyond color.

components.name: Metric & sparkline
components.description: A compact metric pair with comparison badges and a bar chart.

components.name: Floating navigation
components.description: A compact utility rail for switching views. The selected destination has a quiet filled state and an accessible pressed label.

components.name: Avatar & group
components.description: Abstract color avatars provide recognizable identity without depending on photography. Groups show overflow as a count.

components.name: Select & date
components.description: A workspace selector and calendar share the same floating surface, selection colors, and Lucide icons. The calendar supports arrow keys, Home/End, Page Up/Down, Enter, and Escape.

components.name: Score
components.description: A progress ring pairs a numerical score with a written evaluation.

components.name: Progress
components.description: A linear progress bar shows measurable completion with a written value.

components.name: Dropdown menu
components.description: A contextual action list that opens on demand, dismisses on Escape or outside click, and supports keyboard navigation.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Switch related content in place. Tabs expose selected state, are connected to their panels, and support arrow keys.

components.name: Banner
components.description: Inline feedback communicates what happened and whether the user needs to act. Text remains readable in both themes.

components.name: Table
components.description: Compact rows with subtle filled backgrounds. Semantic column headers keep the values understandable to screen readers.

components.name: Card
components.description: A composed container for a project summary. Surface, border, and spacing tokens work independently of product domain.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Choose a value along a range. The live output is associated with the labeled slider and updates on every change.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A focused modal for a single task. Native dialog manages focus containment and Escape. The form validates before confirming.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Transient confirmation after an action. The message is announced through a live status region without moving focus.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short label for an icon action, shown on pointer hover and keyboard focus. It never contains essential instructions.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Navigate a bounded set of pages. Current page and visible item range stay synchronized, including previous and next actions.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Progress through a short sequence with completed, current, and upcoming steps. The demo advances and can be restarted.

components.name: Empty state
components.description: Explain what belongs in an empty space and offer the next useful action.

components.name: Activity list
components.description: A simple timeline pairs an event, context, and time. The connecting line is decorative; event order is semantic.

components.name: Skeleton & spinner
components.description: Static skeletons reserve the shape of loading content. The spinner respects reduced-motion preferences.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Progressively disclose supporting details. Native details elements retain keyboard and screen-reader behavior.

components.name: Funnel
components.description: A flowing stage comparison, with stage names and values available as text.

components.name: Filter chips
components.description: Applied filters are visible and individually removable. Clear all and reset keep the example repeatable.

components.name: Chat composer
components.description: A local AI-chat composer with room to write, attach, and send. Messages are kept locally and announced when added.

components.name: File input
components.description: An empty-state pattern for assets: drop files on the surface or use Select assets. Selection stays on your device.

components.name: Text area
components.description: A multiline field with an associated character counter. Length limits are enforced by the native textarea.

components.name: Session card
components.description: A layered review card. Expand the result row to see what was checked; spacing and shadows keep nested surfaces quiet.

components.name: Selection toolbar
components.description: A compact body toolbar responds to selection. Actions confirm the selected items locally and clear selection after archiving.

components.name: Expandable dock
components.description: A contextual activity switcher opens into a compact realtime summary. Select Realtime to expand; any other destination collapses it.

components.name: App shell
components.description: One navigation system with sidebar and topbar layouts, a collapsible rail, and a keyboard-accessible mobile drawer. Starter screens use the same component.

components.name: Page header & breadcrumbs
components.description: A page title, supporting description, breadcrumb trail, and primary action share a reusable alignment.

components.name: Side drawer
components.description: Inspect and edit a record without losing your place. Native modal semantics keep keyboard focus inside until dismissed.

components.name: Bottom sheet
components.description: A compact action surface rises from the bottom, with Escape and backdrop dismissal.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Small controls appear next to their trigger and dismiss on outside click or Escape.

components.name: Confirmation dialog
components.description: Confirm a consequential action with a clear description, safe cancel action, and explicit outcome.

components.name: Searchable select
components.description: Search a list of options. Arrow keys move the active option; Enter commits and Escape dismisses.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Suggestions narrow as you type. Choose an existing value or keep a custom value.

components.name: Multiselect
components.description: Select several values from a searchable list. Remove selected chips without reopening the list.

components.name: Command palette
components.description: Find screens, components, and common actions with the keyboard. Open anywhere with Command/Ctrl K.

components.name: Number stepper
components.description: Increment, decrement, or enter a number. Boundary buttons disable at the minimum and maximum.

components.name: Password field
components.description: Reveal a password without changing its value. The toggle exposes its pressed state and updates its label.

components.name: Date range picker
components.description: Choose two dates across months, or use a quick preset. Apply commits the selection; cancel preserves the original value.

components.name: Time picker
components.description: A tactile hour-and-minute wheel with momentum scrolling, keyboard control, and explicit confirmation.

components.name: Selectable cards
components.description: A richer radio option combines a title, description, and Lucide icon. Native radio semantics preserve keyboard behavior.

components.name: Simple data table
components.description: A quiet table with one record per line. Sort project names, status, progress, currency, and dates without extra toolbars or bulk controls.

components.name: Data table
components.description: Sort, search, filter, hide columns, select rows, paginate, expand details, and edit records. Actions update local preview data.

components.name: Inline validation
components.description: Associated inline errors explain how to correct an invalid field. Valid input replaces the error with confirmation.

components.name: Error & retry
components.description: Recover from a failed load without losing context. Retry shows a loading state before replacing the error.

components.name: Upload progress
components.description: A bounded progress simulation with cancel and retry. Screen-reader updates announce milestones, not every frame.

components.name: Unsaved changes
components.description: A contextual save bar appears when values differ from the saved version. Discard restores the original.

components.name: Metadata list
components.description: Aligned labels and values display the details that accompany a record.

components.name: Thumbnail & lightbox
components.description: Local abstract artwork demonstrates an asset thumbnail and larger lightbox preview. Escape returns focus to the thumbnail.

components.name: Divider & form section
components.description: A titled section and quiet divider separate related fields without adding another card.

components.name: Agent todo list
components.description: A collapsible task plan with explicit task states and bounded progress.

components.name: Agent message
components.description: A response with source identity and contextual actions.

components.name: Message bubbles
components.description: Role-specific message surfaces.

components.name: Message scroller
components.description: A bounded message history with an explicit jump action.

components.name: Prompt input
components.description: A growing prompt field with a local attachment picker and submit feedback.

components.name: Code block
components.description: Code is preserved as text, with a copy action.

components.name: Approval card
components.description: A decision card that records an explicit choice.

components.name: File diff
components.description: Readable additions and deletions with a review outcome.

components.name: Tool result
components.description: Inspect structured output and run a bounded local simulation.

components.name: Streaming response
components.description: A cancellable response preview. Completion is announced without reading every character.

components.name: Image generation
components.description: Local artwork illustrates generation states; no model service is called.

components.name: Tool approval
components.description: Show the requested scope before the user decides.

components.name: Citations
components.description: Numbered references disclose context next to a response.

components.name: Agent activity
components.description: A chronological record separate from the task plan.

components.name: Agent loading states
components.description: Feedback before a durable task plan is available.

components.name: AI sidebar
components.description: Conversation navigation next to a working composer.

components.name: Chat workspace
components.description: A composed local conversation with retained messages between previews.

components.name: File tree
components.description: Explore nested files with disclosures and preview feedback.

components.name: Preview rail
components.description: A compact artwork selector updates a shared preview.

components.name: OTP input
components.description: One accessible code field supports paste, autofill, and validation.

components.name: Feedback widget
components.description: Collect a rating and optional note within the local preview.

components.name: Notification stack
components.description: A compact inbox with per-notification dismissal.

components.name: Context menu
components.description: Secondary actions open with right-click, Shift F10, or an explicit button.

components.name: Availability scheduler
components.description: Choose a day and available time with explicit confirmation.

components.name: Wheel picker
components.description: A bounded duration list with scroll snapping and keyboard selection.

components.name: Swipeable list
components.description: Pointer swipes and visible actions lead to the same reversible outcome.

components.name: Not found
components.description: An actionable empty route state.

components.name: Range slider
components.description: A budget interval with independent, labeled lower and upper controls.

components.name: Tilt card
components.description: A restrained perspective response on pointer movement, without changing the content hierarchy.

components.name: Marquee
components.description: A pausable horizontal strip. Motion stops when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Pull to refresh
components.description: Refresh a short feed using a downward gesture or accessible button.

components.name: Ambient background
components.description: A lightweight CSS interpretation of the reference shader effect, using only Syntari palette tokens.

components.name: Rotating carousel
components.description: Three artwork cards rotate through a shared stage, with explicit controls and reduced motion.

components.name: Card & project folder
components.description: A folder opens into a compact set of file actions.

components.name: Masonry grid
components.description: An uneven grid with explicit loading instead of an endless automatic fetch.

components.name: Fixtures
components.description: A compact schedule pattern with selectable fixtures and local detail feedback.

components.name: Asset swap
components.description: A local illustrative crypto convert form: each field carries its own asset select, enter an amount, and review the order. No wallet, trading, or network transaction is connected.

components.name: Status island
components.description: A dark floating surface reveals task context without switching pages.

components.name: Overflow actions
components.description: Low-frequency actions share the standard Syntari menu surface.

components.name: Wallet card
components.description: A sample account surface with concealed balance and a copyable demonstration identifier.

components.name: Prediction card
components.description: A product-planning prediction sample with local choices; no betting or payment.

components.name: Bloom menu
components.description: Circular actions float above a central trigger that clearly changes between Create and Close.

components.name: Morphing search
components.description: An inline search expands in place and filters a small set of recent projects.

components.name: Action swap
components.description: A single action changes its label and icon as work progresses.

components.name: Agent questions
components.description: A small guided approval flow combines radio options, free text, and a reviewable result.

components.name: Chart bars
components.description: Grouped columns compare two series across periods, with the numbers in a summary a screen reader can read.

components.name: Chart line
components.description: A line chart with points and a quiet grid. Series colours come from the shared tokens rather than a palette of their own.

components.name: Chart donut
components.description: A ring shows how one whole splits, with the total held in the centre and a legend carrying the exact numbers.

components.name: Heatmap
components.description: A compact grid where one intensity ramp carries the comparison, with the scale beside it.

components.name: Treemap
components.description: Tiles sized by share, so the shape of the whole is readable before any number is.

components.name: Network graph
components.description: Relationships drawn as nodes and edges, with the busiest node carrying the emphasis.

components.name: Gantt chart
components.description: Rows of work with a span and a marker for today, at a grain people can read at a glance.

components.name: Comparison table
components.description: The same metric measured across options, with the advantage column naming the winner in words rather than colour alone.

components.name: Stat row
components.description: A row of measures with a label, a value, a change, and the note that explains it.

components.name: Process ledger
components.description: A pipeline shown as stages with their durations and a total, so the cost of each step is visible.

components.name: Transport controls
components.description: Controls for something that runs: play, pause, step, and a speed that states its own value.

components.name: Live readout
components.description: A small panel of measures with a live status, for anything that changes while someone watches.

components.name: Feature grid
components.description: A short row of capabilities: an icon, a claim, the explanation, and the footnote that qualifies it.

components.name: Pricing table
components.description: A plan matrix where included, limited, and absent stay readable without relying on colour.

components.name: CTA band
components.description: A closing call to action: one statement, one next step, and no competing links.

components.name: Page footer
components.description: The end of a page: the mark, the promise, grouped links, and whether the service is up.

components.name: Area chart
components.description: A line with its area filled, a labelled axis, and gridlines. The summary states the range for screen readers.

components.name: Chart toolbar
components.description: The controls that belong above a chart: a comparison, a view switch, and room for a legend.

components.name: Metric strip
components.description: A row of measures where the active one is the thing being charted. Choosing another changes the focus.

components.name: Headline metric
components.description: The one number a screen is about, with an optional total it is measured against.

components.name: Filter bar
components.description: The row that scopes a view: a period selector, a filter action, and the chips that describe the current scope.

components.name: Source list
components.description: A short ranked list with share bars, for the sources or answers behind a number.
